features.name: Reload the TLS certificate on SIGHUP without a restart

features.name: Flaky test: 100 waits on a 4-connection pool
features.description: test/repro-wait-hold-routing.test.ts, '100 waits without QueueEvents on a 4-connection pool learn of completion at once', failed once in the sandbox unit suite on a state-and-docs-only tree: expect(completedAt.size).toBe(100) received 80 after 2.1 s (artifacts/test-sandbox/2026-11-13T03-10-31.902Z/, unit 11786 pass / 1 fail / 402 skip); it passed in every other sandbox run that day. Reproduce first (stress the file under CPU contention), then decide whether the test's 100-completion wait is too short or the broker loses completion notifications under load; do not weaken what it asserts.
features.evidence: 2026-11-13, base bfa290c7; lands in the commit that adds this entry. bun run test:sandbox green on tree 33c63200 (unit 11787 / 0 / 402, tcp 553 / 0 / 0, embedded 349 / 0 / 0; artifacts/test-sandbox/2026-11-13T12-04-09.205Z/), the only change after it being this state update; skeptic PASS. Host checks before the gate: , gates pending. 2026-11-13, base bfa290c7, uncommitted (staged). Root cause in the test, not the broker: it asserted completedAt.size === 100 the moment the last waitUntilFinished resolved, but the broker wakes a held WaitJob while it applies the worker's ACKB (handleAckBatch replies after ackBatchWithResults), and the Worker emits 'completed' only after the ACKB reply reaches its own connection (processor.ts), so the last waits can resolve first; worker ACKs are batched by 10, matching the observed 80 and 90. Reproduction on the macOS host (load average about 21 from other sessions): unchanged test -t '100 waits' --rerun-each 30 failed 1 / 30 (received 90); with 18 extra 'yes' busy loops --rerun-each 40 failed 2 / 40 (received 90 both times). A diagnostic copy (scratchpad, not committed) that keeps polling after the waits resolved found the count short in 3 / 40 runs (90 each) and 100 events in 40 / 40 runs, the missing ones about 0.1 ms after the last wait, p90 delay at most 2.1 ms: no notification is lost. Fix: the test waits up to 5 s (polling every 5 ms) for all 100 worker events, then asserts the same two things, size 100 and p90 delay under 400 ms; every delay now uses a real event timestamp. No src/ change. Docs: docs/features/client-queue-sdk.md (TCP wait without QueueEvents: a held wait is not ordered after the Worker's completed event), changelog [Unreleased] Testing. Host checks (diagnostic): fixed test under the same 18-loop load --rerun-each 50 50 pass / 0 fail; whole file --rerun-each 5 20 / 0; bun run typecheck clean (902 + 2,110 files); bun run format:check clean (2312 files); git diff --check clean; ./init.sh green. bun run test:model and bun run test:sandbox:sdk not triggered (no src/ or sdk/ change). Not run: bun run test:sandbox (coordinator), skeptic, commit
